name: Process: Build the first module set before the cohort, by the leads and the founders
text_content:
P9 and P34. The platform does not exist before the team does, and the first modules cannot be authored by "any qualified team member" because there are none. The first set is built as documents under the document methodology by the leads for their domains, the kitchen's domain owners for the kitchen, and the founders for the why block's structure part and the system modules, covers the entry horizon only, is approved by the other lead and a founder side by side, and is marked version one until the first training services revise it through the week-four check-in line. No cohort start date is committed before the seat's set exists. Completion is recorded from Trainual's own record and never from a lead's memory. Blocks every cohort start date. Urgent.

Filed by Session 7 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task 86ajgmhrz. Reasoning lives on the S7 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.
